seen_animation: Frames 1-2: a cup seen from above and slightly to the side: a large domed opening with three vertical strokes, a short tapered body below, and small dashes inside (grains). Frames 3-4: the cup tilts and moves right; a grey hand outline appears at its lower right. Frames 5-8: the cup rotates clockwise and drifts right, the body is seen more from the side with two band strokes, the dashes thin out to one or two marks. Frames 9-12: the cup is more upright, three vertical strokes, two body bands, no dashes left; the grey hand fades away by frame 11. Frames 13-16: the cup moves left and rotates the other way, the body foreshortens, and a curved stroke appears inside the opening (the bottom of the empty cup); it holds there to the end.
seen_film: Frames 1-2: looking straight down into a white cup holding dark grains, a dark gloved hand barely visible. Frames 3-8: the hand tilts the cup to the right; a paper label inside the cup becomes visible and the grains slide; the cup moves toward frame right. Frames 9-12 (after a cut): close view of the cup tipped with its pour spout at left, now mostly empty, the background turns pale. Frames 13-16 (another cut): looking down into the emptied cup at frame left, with a ring of leftover grains at the bottom and the inner base circle visible; it holds.
named_subject: A plastic cup (measuring cup) of grains being tilted and emptied, seen from above.
evidence: e.png 1-6 hold the full cup with grain dashes as f.png 1-6 holds; e.png 8 the grey hand enters as the glove becomes visible in f.png 8; e.png 9-24 the cup tilts clockwise and moves right with the hand at lower right, matching f.png 9-24 where the cup tilts right and the label shows; e.png 25-32 the cup has no grain dashes and the hand fades, matching f.png 25-32 where the cup is tipped and empty; e.png 41-50 the cup sits further left with an inner curve for the base, matching f.png 41-50 looking into the emptied cup at frame left. The position changes at e.png 17, 25 and 41 land on the same frames as the film's cuts/shifts (f.png 17, 25, 41). Within each section the drawing changes in small steps. Judged from still frames only, not playback.
primary_gap: In e.png 25-32 the cup stands nearly upright and centered, while in f.png 25-32 it is tipped hard toward frame left with the pour spout as the most prominent feature, so the pouring/tipping beat is weaker in the animation than in the film.
closes_when: In e.png 25-32 the cup outline leans toward the left with a drawn pointed spout on the left rim, and grain dashes leave along that spout, before the empty-cup view at 33.
protect: The doodle's three vertical rim strokes and two body band strokes kept in every frame; the single-weight wobbly line; the cut-aligned position changes at 17, 25, 41; the grain dashes that thin out and disappear as the cup empties; the grey hand as scenery; the held empty cup with its inner base curve at 41-50.
identity_gap: When seen from above (e.png 1-24, 41-50) the rim is drawn as a large dome rather than the doodle's flat ellipse, so in those frames the cup reads partly like a helmet; frames 25-40 match the doodle most closely.
